name: RocketReach
summary: Search and look up professionals and companies: work and personal emails, phones, job history and firmographics.

api_key.description: A RocketReach API key (rocketreach.co/account, API section). Sent in the Api-Key header.

notes: Rate limits are per plan and per API (search, lookup, company search, bulk), on top of a global 10 requests per second; a 429 carries Retry-After in seconds.

Person lookups are asynchronous: the first answer may have status waiting, searching or progress; poll /person/checkStatus with the profile id (or the RR-Request-ID header value) until complete or failed.
Search returns profiles without contact details; a lookup on a profile id spends export credits and returns the emails and phones.
The 'Universal' API variants (universal credits) are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get account details and usage
endpoints.summary: The account object: plan, usage and limits.

endpoints.name: Search people by criteria
endpoints.summary: Profiles matching title, employer, location, skills and other filters, without contact details.

query.description: Filters, each a list of strings: current_title, employer, company_domain, company_name, geo, department, management_levels, skills, keyword, name, email, link, company_size, company_industry and many more (see docs).

start.description: Start index of the results, counting from 1.

order_by.description: Ordering; default relevance. popularity matches the web app.

notes: Some filters (intent, health_*) are only available on certain plans.

endpoints.name: Look up a person's contact details
endpoints.summary: A profile with emails and phones, by profile id, LinkedIn URL, email, phone, NPI number, or name plus current employer.

email.description: An email address of the person.

phone.description: A phone number, E.164 or international format.

name.description: Full name; must go with current_employer.

current_employer.description: Current employer; must go with name.

title.description: Job title, to narrow the match.

return_cached_emails.description: Whether cached emails come back while status is progress; false keeps email fields null until the lookup completes.

webhook_id.description: Id of a webhook (API settings page) to receive the finished result.

notes: May answer before the lookup finishes (status waiting, searching or progress): poll rocketreach.people.lookup_status.

endpoints.name: Check person lookup status
endpoints.summary: Status (complete, failed, waiting, searching, progress) and data of earlier lookups.

rr_request_id.description: The RR-Request-ID header of a lookup or bulk lookup answer; wins over ids.

notes: RocketReach recommends a webhook over polling.

endpoints.name: Look up a person and their company
endpoints.summary: A person's profile with contact details plus their current company's data, in one call.

email.description: An email address of the person.

phone.description: A phone number, E.164 or international format.

name.description: Full name; must go with current_employer.

current_employer.description: Current employer; must go with name.

title.description: Job title, to narrow the match.

webhook_id.description: Id of a webhook to receive the finished result.

endpoints.name: Search companies by criteria
endpoints.summary: Companies matching name, domain, industry, location, size, funding, tech stack or signal filters.

query.description: Filters, each a list of strings: name, domain, industry, geo, location, employees, revenue, techstack, total_funding, naics_code, sic_code, keyword, news_signal and more (see docs).

start.description: Start index of the results, counting from 1.

notes: A read over POST. Use rocketreach.company.lookup for a match's full record.

endpoints.name: Look up a company
endpoints.summary: A company's record by domain, id, LinkedIn URL, name or ticker.
notes: Needs company exports on the plan (sales@rocketreach.co).

endpoints.name: Verify an email address
endpoints.summary: Whether one email address can receive mail.
notes: A read over POST. Charges one email verification credit, refunded when the result is unknown or the address is malformed.
